notes.title: V428
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Some new accessories to unlock
[*] Added stats for total accessories and colors unlocked
[*] Snowing is now correctly only on Santa
[*] Three heads now correctly disappear when using random
[*] Added another check to look for leaderboard/local discrepancies.
[*] Now toggle between three transparency modes for Twitch, background, background and clouds, background and clouds but keep twitch clouds.
[*] improved various small visuals here and there
[*] some other bug fixes i forgot to write down
[*] updated special spawns so missing ones occur more often (this makes sense)
[*] improved versioning tools so keeping track of future updates and hardware platforms will be WAY easier, for me at least.
[*] splash sound properly follows your volume settings
[*] Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues.
[/list]

(hotfixes galore, been resolving issues for saves between win, mac, linux, steamdeck, should be all good now)

Thanks :)
-adamvision

notes.title: V1.01
notes.content:
Hey, thanks for playing ya'll, please continue to share Flip Flop XL with your friends, family and enemies. I have fixed a few bugs and improved some stuff. More to come too.  -adamvision

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Headphones accessory 3d audio improved
[*] Rain should now always land correctly?
[*] Global / Friends leaderboard should correctly show now
[*] (Twitch) chatter names now always fit
[*] (Twitch) reroll no longer clears score
[*] (Twitch) press "x" on keyboard to clear all queues, double tap to clear all scores
[*] (Twitch) chat auto-joining now has three queue levels. Priority (for 100 bits), Standard (for anyone chatting in chat or using commands) and Previous (if chat isn't chatting, it'll pull in previous chatters to keep flipping)
[*] (Twitch) Changed greenscreen modes, now is transparent mode and OBS Game Capture can use transparencies for an improved overlay, WAY better.
[/list]
